The plate is a square side plate, roughly 20-22 cm across (about 330 px in the image). The carrots sit in a pile about 5-6 cm across and look like glazed carrot slices, with roughly 12 pieces. A few more pieces lie off to the side.

For weight, each piece is about 5-8 g, so about 15 pieces come to roughly 100 g. With a little glaze, I'll say 110 g.

Cooked carrots are about 40 kcal per 100 g, or around 60 kcal per 100 g with glaze. That puts 110 g at about 60 kcal, so I'll say 65.
